correctness.rationale: Primitive-root classes count φ(p−1), and CRT local squarefree failure classes modulo p² number r_p=p²−1−pφ(p−1), including p=2. Möbius inversion on square divisors coprime to Q(y) yields uniform S_N=(N/ζ2)B(y)+O(Q(y)^2√N), while U_N=NA(y)+O(Q(y)). PNT implies log Q(y)~y, lower bounds A,B≥(1/3)2^{-π(y)} ensure relative uniformity y≤(1/4−ε)log N. The correction e_p=φ(p−1)/[p(p²−1)(1−φ(p−1)/p)] has absolutely summable O(p^-2), yielding strict 0<K<1 and its decimal interval from exact product plus tail. Independent arithmetic product through p=31 gave 0.59392625 before tail, consistent with K≈0.59167.
residual_risks: Finite prime product to 31 does not prove numerical enclosure; exact outward-rounded certificate in source VERIFY.py was inspected but not independently rerun to L=100000.
